title: Debug and fix error preventing products from displaying on home page

requirements.text: Investigate and identify the specific error occurring on the deployed home page that prevents products from displaying in Version 12
acceptanceCriteria: Error message and stack trace are identified from browser console or deployment logs
Root cause of the error is determined (e.g., network request failure, data transformation issue, rendering exception)

requirements.text: Fix the identified error in the ProductsPage component or useProducts hook that is preventing products from rendering on the main products page
acceptanceCriteria: ProductsPage successfully fetches products from the backend without throwing errors
Products are rendered in the UI with correct images, names, prices, and add-to-cart buttons
No console errors related to product fetching or rendering appear in the deployed application

requirements.text: Verify that the backend getAllProducts function returns product data in the expected format with all required fields (id, name, description, price, category, imageUrl)
acceptanceCriteria: Backend getAllProducts function returns an array of products with all required fields
Product data matches the type signature expected by the frontend TypeScript interfaces
Sample products (masalas, groceries, food oils) are present in the returned data

requirements.text: Add error boundary or try-catch handling to the ProductsPage component to gracefully handle and display any runtime errors that occur during product fetching or rendering
acceptanceCriteria: ProductsPage displays a user-friendly error message if product fetching fails
Error details are logged to console for debugging purposes
Application does not crash when errors occur in ProductsPage

constraints: Do not change the backend schema or product data structure
Preserve existing console logging for debugging purposes
Maintain compatibility with React Query hooks and TanStack Router
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond fixing the current error
Redesigning the ProductsPage UI or layout
Modifying the search functionality or filtering logic
